;Business and economy
*[[2018 China–United States trade war]]
**[[America]]n [[tariff]]s of 25% on approximately $16 billion worth of Chinese goods come into effect. [[China]] immediately responds with equivalent tariffs of its own. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/u-s-china-impose-further-tariffs-escalating-trade-war-idUSKCN1L809K (Reuters)]
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[government of the United Kingdom]] publishes the first 25 of 80 planned "technical notices" providing practical guidance to businesses in case of a [[Brexit negotiations#The "no deal" scenario|no-deal Brexit]]. [http://fortune.com/2018/08/23/uk-business-guidance-no-deal-brexit/ (''Fortune'')]
**[[Chancellor of Austria|Austrian Chancellor]] [[Sebastian Kurz]], whose country holds the rotating [[European Union]] presidency, expresses interest in avoiding a hard [[Brexit]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-austria/austrias-kurz-wants-to-help-eus-barnier-avoid-a-hard-brexit-idUSKCN1L829F (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Lane (2018)|Hurricane Lane]] causes flash flooding, and threatens a direct hit towards [[Hawaii]] as it passes through [[Oahu]]. Over {{convert|19|inch|cm|sigfig=2}} of rain has already fallen in some areas. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/23/us/hurricane-lane-hawaii-wxc/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[South Africa–United States relations]], [[South African farm attacks]], [[Fox News controversies]]
**The [[government of South Africa]] rejects a tweet by [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] as "based on false information", in which he appeared to respond to a [[Fox News]] report stating that the South African government is "now seizing land from white farmers." [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/23/africa/trump-south-africa-intl/index.html (CNN)] {{Contradict-inline|date=August 2018}} <!-- August 20 below states "*The [[South Africa|South African]] government begins the process of seizing land from white farm owners. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/news/article.cfm?c_id=2&objectid=12110366 (''NZ Herald'')]" -->
*[[Crisis in Bolivarian Venezuela]]
**[[Ecuador–Venezuela relations]], [[ALBA|Bolivarian Alliance]]
***[[Ecuador]] leaves the Bolivarian alliance of nations run in Latin America, citing the behaviour of the [[Venezuela]]n government in several areas including attempting to impose Chavism in America, creating major crises, and ineffectual control of migration. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ecuador-leaves-venezuelan-run-regional-alliance-57371446 (ABC News)], [https://www.elcomercio.com/actualidad/ecuador-fueraalba-crisismigracion-venezuela-hugochavez.html (''El Comercio'')]
**[[Colombia-Venezuela relations]]
***In response to the Venezuelan [[Bolivarian National Guard]]'s armed infiltration of [[Norte de Santander]], [[Colombia]] four days ago, Venezuela releases a statement calling it "supposed" and "fake news", despite clear video of Venezuelan helicopters in Colombian territory. [http://www.ntn24.com/america-latina/el-informativo-ntn24/colombia/revelan-video-del-momento-de-incursion-venezolana-en (NTN24)]
**[[Bolivarian diaspora]], [[Venezuela–Colombia migrant crisis]]
***[[Colombia]] announces that it will host a summit in [[Bogotá]] with migration officials from [[Peru]] and [[Ecuador]] in an attempt to seek a solution for the growing illegal immigration of [[Venezuela]]ns through their nations. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-migration-summit/colombia-to-host-meeting-with-ecuador-peru-on-venezuelan-migrant-issue-idUSKCN1L82H3 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**Authorities arrest 32-year old John Colin Eagle Skoda after investigators concluded that a debris fire he started turned into a 60-square-mile blaze that killed one person and destroyed 35 homes. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/northern-california-man-arrested-deadly-wildfire-57369418 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill, 2018]]
**[[Australia]]n [[Australian House of Representatives|MP]] [[Peter Dutton]] claims that [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Malcolm Turnbull]] has lost the support of the majority of the [[Liberal Party of Australia|Liberal Party]] and calls for another leadership vote. Turnbull states that he will resign if another spill is called. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-08-23/live-peter-dutton-poised-to-challenge-malcolm-turnbull-again/10155008?section=politics (''ABC'')] [https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/liberal-leadership-crisis-dutton-forces-intensify-push-for-second-challenge-20180823-p4zz66.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-politics-turnbull/australia-pm-unlikely-to-contest-another-leadership-vote-sky-news-idUSKCN1L802C (Reuters)]
